caseName: New York & New Jersey Water Co. v. Passaic Consolidated Water Co.
caseNameFull: New York and New Jersey Water Co. v. Passaic Consolidated Water Co.
attorneys: Mr. Robert H. McCarter for1 appellants., Mr. Frederick J. Faulks, with whom Mr. J. N. Bishop, Jr., was on the brief, for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The appeal is dismissed for want of a substantial federal question on the authority of Shulthis v. McDougal, 225 U. S. 561, 569; Hull v. Burr, 234 U. S. 712, 720; Norton v. Whiteside, 239 U. S. 144, 147.

Mr. Frederick J. Faulks, with whom Mr. J. N. Bishop, Jr., was on the brief, for appellee.
